headline: Paraguay President Santiago Peña Impeached and Arrested Amid Ueno Bank Crisis
summary: Following an impeachment by lawmakers over a financial scandal involving Ueno Bank and frozen customer savings, Paraguayan prosecutors issued an arrest warrant for former President Santiago Peña, and Pedro Alliana assumed the presidency.
why: Political instability and severe banking crises in emerging markets can disrupt local financial systems, freeze customer assets, and trigger cross-border contagion risks for regional operations.

impacts.name: Paraguay
impacts.why: Presidential impeachment and a severe commercial bank collapse threaten domestic economic stability.
